## KB Entry Search — Daily Jira Scan

Run this JQL query against the Jira API to find newly resolved tickets that may need troubleshooting knowledge base entries:

```
project in (FE, MP, BE) AND status IN (Closed, Release) AND (description ~ "root cause" OR description ~ "solution" OR description ~ "fix")
```

1. Execute the JQL via the configured Jira API (ctil.atlassian.net, andrew_au@ctil.com)
2. Check if there are **new tickets** not already documented in `03-Resources/troubleshooting/`
3. For new tickets, fetch descriptions and comments to evaluate root cause quality
4. Present findings to the user and ask if they want to create notes

Existing troubleshooting notes: `03-Resources/troubleshooting/`
MOC index: `03-Resources/troubleshooting/index.md`
